findings.title: approve_change_order stamps APPROVED from DRAFT or REJECTED, skipping the enforced review gates
findings.description: ChangeOrderProcessor documents DRAFT → PENDING_REVIEW → PENDING_APPROVAL → APPROVED. submit_for_review() and submit_for_approval() enforce prior states, but approve_change_order() never checks status—it appends an ApprovalRecord and sets APPROVED/approved_date from any state including DRAFT and REJECTED. get_summary() then counts the forged CO into total_approved / contract impact. Live system-of-record (export Excel / summary).
findings.impact: A colluding PM/contractor agent can mint a six-figure APPROVED change order without review, or resurrect a REJECTED CO as approved. Owner pay-apps and revised contract totals follow that register.
attack_path: 1. Operator deploys ChangeOrderProcessor as the project CO register.
2. Attacker create_change_order + add_cost_item (stays DRAFT).
3. Attacker approve_change_order(co, approver=any, role=any) without submit_for_review.
4. Status is APPROVED; summary/export treat it as owner-approved cost.
5. Alternate: reject_change_order then approve_change_order → REJECTED flips to APPROVED.
findings.remediation: Allow approve_change_order only from PENDING_APPROVAL. Reject transitions from DRAFT/REJECTED. Require a distinct prior reviewer identity.
findings.poc: DRAFT steel package → APPROVED $302,500; REJECTED→APPROVED on second CO

findings.title: approve_change_order jumps DRAFT→APPROVED with attacker-chosen amount; photos/backup unused
findings.description: ChangeOrderManager workflow documents Identify→Document→Price→Negotiate→Execute with photo/backup evidence fields, and execute_change_order correctly requires APPROVED. approve_change_order() sets APPROVED and writes approved_amount/approved_time_days from any prior status with no SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW check and no requirement that photo_attachments or backup_documents be non-empty. get_summary().total_approved / revised_contract publish the forged award.
findings.impact: DRAFT CO approved at $2.5M with empty evidence revises a $1M contract to $3.5M on the official summary—claim/payment inflation without documentation.
attack_path: 1. Deploy ChangeOrderManager as the curated CO log (get_summary / notes audit trail).
2. create_change_order leaves DRAFT with empty photo_attachments/backup_documents.
3. approve_change_order(co_id, approved_amount=2500000, approved_time=120).
4. get_summary reports total_approved=2500000, revised_contract=3500000.
findings.remediation: Require SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW and non-empty backup/photo evidence before APPROVED. Cap approved_amount against proposed pricing; dual-control approver.

findings.title: can_release_payment authorizes on RECEIVED/VERIFIED waivers with empty file_path; verify skips RECEIVED
findings.description: LienWaiverTracker is the payment-release gate (description: ensure waivers before payments; can_release_payment returns can_release + amount). receive_waiver() accepts file_path="" and stamps RECEIVED. can_release_payment treats RECEIVED or VERIFIED as sufficient and returns can_release=True with reason 'All waivers verified' even when never verified and file_path is empty. verify_waiver() also jumps REQUESTED→VERIFIED with no file. Distinct from toolkit subcontractor-payment-tracker (separate skill).
findings.impact: Subcontractor progress payment releases against a phantom waiver. Lien exposure and owner payment controls treat missing PDFs as verified.
attack_path: 1. Deploy LienWaiverTracker; create_payment_application auto-requests conditional waiver.
2. Attacker receive_waiver(id, file_path='') or verify_waiver(id, 'forger') without a file.
3. can_release_payment → can_release=True and amount=approved net.
4. AP releases funds; exposure math assumes waivers exist.
findings.remediation: Require non-empty file_path and VERIFIED (not mere RECEIVED) before can_release=True. Block verify_waiver unless RECEIVED with a stored file.
findings.poc: empty file RECEIVED → can_release True $90k; REQUESTED→VERIFIED skip file → can_release True $45k

findings.title: record_payment sets PAID without APPROVED, lien waiver, or insurance; uncapped vs contract
findings.description: SubcontractorPaymentTracker is the live sub payment register (export_report / get_summary / get_missing_waivers). record_payment() writes PAID from INVOICED with no APPROVED gate and no lien_waiver check. insurance_expiry and license_number are stored on Subcontractor but never consulted. Invoices can exceed contract_amount. get_missing_waivers only reports AFTER PAID—advisory, not a gate. Quick Start itself pays before attaching a waiver.
findings.impact: Pay $810k against a $500k steel contract with null insurance and no waivers; missing_waivers=2 only after cash has left. Lien and insurance compliance are post-facto.
attack_path: 1. Deploy tracker as payment SoR.
2. record_invoice large amounts; skip approve_payment.
3. record_payment → PAID; insurance_expiry remains None; lien_waiver None.
4. export_report / total_paid used for AP and owner draws.
findings.remediation: Allow PAID only from APPROVED with a stored waiver and non-expired insurance_expiry. Cap cumulative paid+retention at contract_amount.
findings.poc: two invoices → PAID $810k on $500k contract; waiver=None; insurance=None; missing_waivers=2

findings.title: _find_available_crane ignores Equipment.capacity and schedule; assigns 5t crane to 40t steel
findings.description: DeliveryScheduler is the site JIT/crane assignment engine (Quick Start / get_daily_schedule). Equipment.capacity (tons) is defined but _find_available_crane only checks equipment_type=='crane' and check_crane_coverage (max_reach). Comment admits schedule is unchecked. schedule_deliveries therefore assigns a 5-ton crane to a 40-ton structural delivery and can double-book the same crane on overlapping unload windows.
findings.impact: Official lift plan dispatches an under-capacity crane for structural steel—dropped-load / tip-over path on assigned_crane.
attack_path: 1. Operator deploys SiteLogisticsModel + DeliveryScheduler for crane-required deliveries.
2. Fleet has CR1 capacity=5t within reach of laydown zone.
3. DeliveryRequest quantity=40 tons requires_crane=True.
4. schedule_deliveries assigns assigned_crane='CR1'; second 35t delivery also gets CR1.
findings.remediation: Compare delivery.quantity (tons) to crane.capacity at radius; fail closed when over capacity. Track crane busy intervals and refuse overlaps.
findings.poc: 5t CR1 assigned to 40t and 35t steel deliveries same day

findings.title: Same-group substitutes hardcode similarity=0.7 so C40→C20 / S355→S235 enter batch savings as best_substitute
findings.description: CWICRMaterialSubstitution is the VE / cost-saving substitute engine (find_cost_saving_alternatives / batch_substitution / export_substitution_report). When materials share a MATERIAL_GROUPS keyword hit, similarity is hardcoded to 0.7 with no grade/strength check. batch_substitution auto-picks the cheapest as best_substitute. PoC: structural C40 → lean C20 ($25k 'savings' on 500 m³); S355 → S235 ($40k on 200 t).
findings.impact: Official VE report recommends structural downgrades as savings. Specs/GMP can lock in non-compliant concrete/steel.
attack_path: 1. Deploy CWICRMaterialSubstitution against project QTO.
2. batch_substitution on C40/S355 packages.
3. Report lists C20/S235 as best_substitute with potential_savings.
4. Procurement orders the cheaper grade.
findings.remediation: Parse and compare strength grades; never hardcode group similarity. Exclude DOWNGRADE from batch best_substitute unless an engineer override flag is set.

findings.title: get_statistics counts created inspections as completed; CRITICAL hazards close without photos
findings.description: SafetyManager is the field safety SoR (generate_daily_safety_report / get_statistics). inspections_completed equals count of create_inspection records—no checklist completion required (PoC: all results None still counts 1). correct_hazard → verify_hazard_closure closes CRITICAL with photo_urls=[]. Failed checklist items only print a warning; hazards are optional.
findings.impact: Daily safety briefing and TRIR-adjacent dashboards show completed inspections and closed critical fall-protection hazards with zero evidence.
attack_path: 1. Deploy SafetyManager as site safety log.
2. create_inspection only; get_statistics.inspections_completed=1.
3. add_hazard CRITICAL; correct_hazard without photo; verify_hazard_closure.
4. Daily briefing omits the hazard from open lists.
findings.remediation: Count inspections only when every checklist item has a result. Require photo evidence before VERIFIED on CRITICAL/HIGH.
findings.poc: inspections_completed=1 with checklist_done=False; CRITICAL → Verified Closed, photos=[]

findings.title: generate_daily_report marks COMPLIANT with zero readings; record_batch swallows bad ingest
findings.description: EnvironmentalMonitor publishes DailyReport.compliance_status used as the regulatory compliance register. With stations configured but no readings, check_compliance returns [] and generate_daily_report else-branch sets COMPLIANT. record_batch bare except: pass drops poisoned/unknown-station rows, so exceedances never land and the day still reports compliant.
findings.impact: Dust/noise/vibration compliance packages show COMPLIANT on days with no monitoring data—regulatory false clearance for work continuation.
attack_path: 1. Deploy EnvironmentalMonitor; add_station for PM10/noise.
2. Skip readings (or feed bad station ids swallowed by record_batch).
3. generate_daily_report → compliance_status=compliant, readings_collected=0.
4. Daily environmental report / owner package uses that status.
findings.remediation: Fail closed to NO_DATA/NON_COMPLIANT when required parameters have zero readings. Do not swallow record_batch exceptions; surface ingest failures.
findings.poc: 0 readings → compliant; bad batch swallowed count=0

findings.title: update_status(DELIVERED) forges receipt without receive_delivery; storage capacity unused
findings.description: MaterialDeliveryTracker is the delivery schedule SoR (export_schedule / get_summary). update_status accepts any DeliveryStatus including DELIVERED without setting receiver, actual_date, or quantity_received. receive_delivery is the intended receipt path. StorageArea.capacity_sqm/current_usage_sqm are never updated on receipt. PoC: DELIVERED with receiver='', qty_received=0, actual_date=None.
findings.impact: Critical-path materials show delivered for look-ahead/OTD metrics while never received—false make-ready.
attack_path: 1. schedule_delivery + add_item for structural steel.
2. update_status(..., DELIVERED) skipping receive_delivery.
3. Summary/export treat delivery complete.
findings.remediation: Allow DELIVERED only via receive_delivery with receiver and quantities. Enforce storage capacity on assign.

findings.title: update_status(DELIVERED) from REQUISITIONED with empty PO/vendor
findings.description: MaterialProcurementTracker is the long-lead procurement log (export_log / get_summary). update_status writes any ProcurementStatus and on DELIVERED stamps actual_delivery=today without requiring PO_ISSUED, vendor, or po_number. issue_po is skippable. Critical firestop can show delivered with po=''.
findings.impact: Life-safety / long-lead materials marked on-site without a purchase order—false schedule readiness and audit gap.
attack_path: 1. add_item CRITICAL firestop REQUISITIONED.
2. update_status(DELIVERED) without issue_po.
3. export_log shows Delivered with empty Vendor/PO.
findings.remediation: Allow DELIVERED only from SHIPPED/IN_PRODUCTION after issue_po with non-empty vendor and po_number.

findings.title: RFID location substring 'zone'/'floor' forges MaterialStatus.IN_USE without delivery verification
findings.description: MaterialTrackingSystem + IoTMessageHandler is the live IoT inventory (get_inventory_report / dashboard). _process_rfid_reading sets IN_USE whenever new_location contains 'zone' or 'floor', regardless of prior DELIVERED/QC. process_message has no auth on MQTT payloads. PoC: ORDERED firestop + RFID at 'Building A Zone 5' → status=in_use.
findings.impact: Unverified / un-received life-safety materials appear installed in inventory dashboards; MQTT spoof can move status.
attack_path: 1. Deploy MaterialTrackingSystem; register material ORDERED with RFID.
2. Spoof or scan RFID at a location string containing 'zone'.
3. Status becomes IN_USE; inventory report reflects installed.
findings.remediation: Require DELIVERED (and QC pass) before IN_USE. Authenticate MQTT ingest; do not key status off location substrings alone.
